input.question: What were the last places in the world to outlaw slavery and when did they abolish the practice?
input.ground_truth: I hope this qualifies as a top level comment, but, there are still places where Slavery's illegal status is unenforced. [Mauritania](_URL_0_) had a pretty high-profile article written on it last year. Technically it abolished Slavery in 1981, and made it illegal in 2007, though last year's report indicates that that it is still occuring there with regularity.

Question: What were the last places in the world to outlaw slavery and when did they abolish the practice?

Answer:

Okay! Imagine you have a big, big world with lots of countries. Some countries stopped saying it’s okay to own other people as slaves a long, long time ago. But some places waited much longer.

The very last place to stop slavery was a country called Mauritania. They said it was not okay to have slaves in the year 1981. That’s like when your great-great-grandparents were little kids! Most other countries stopped much earlier, but Mauritania was the last one to say, “No more slavery!”
